scope: Valid PEP613 explicit TypeAlias declarations in runtime module/class scope with statically resolved type-only bindings. This is not a general runtime NameError checker.

repaired_overreach.annotation-only-name: No initialized/resolved value binding; actual selected namespace audit reports F821, not TC007. Original runtime failure remains recorded.
repaired_overreach.forward-runtime-class: An ordinary unresolved forward class name reports F821, not this type-checking-only-binding diagnostic.
repaired_overreach.function-local-shadow: PEP613 prohibits explicit aliases in function scope. Python runtime failure is not a sufficient TC007 precondition.
repaired_overreach.function-local-builtin-shadow: Same invalid alias scope; no TC007 repair is implied by the runtime UnboundLocalError.

valid_class_control: A separate valid module-level class-scope TypeAlias whose only Foo binding is guarded stays positive; scope repair does not blanket-exclude classes.

discrepancies.runtime-fallback-deleted: The earlier runtime Foo class is deleted. Its stale binding cannot make the guarded imported Foo available. Exact original CPython3.10 execution raises NameError; the nondeleted fallback control succeeds and the guard-only baseline is diagnosed.
discrepancies.shadowed-true-guard: The local TYPE_CHECKING name is explicitly rebound True, so its class executes and Alias is Foo. The reference name-based heuristic still treats the body as type-only. This is an exact runtime-availability false positive from an intentional over-approximation, not a general claim that Ruff implements Python incorrectly or that the full program is well typed.

primary_basis.basis: Explicit aliases are supported at module/class scope; not function-local scope.
Deleting a name removes its binding.
The standard typing constant is False at runtime. An explicitly rebound local name is not that imported constant.
TC007 concerns explicit type aliases containing references unavailable at runtime; quoting the type expression is its suggested repair.

versions: Canonical target3.12; actual exact module-source controls use only TypeAlias3.10 syntax and execute on CPython3.10.19. Source lookup, assignment and del semantics are unchanged in3.12. Full upstream fixture includes3.12 type statements and is not claimed to execute on3.10.
no_broad_waiver: Only two exact unchanged sources and their complete two diagnostic multisets are certified. The four corrected-scope controls remain negative without discrepancy annotations.
